relations.rationale: Rounds progressing has no bearing on the number of houses at the school.
Pairing rotation and comparing standings on a chalkboard are separate activities with no logical connection.
If Xavi and Mina were both a year older than Fay, they would be the same age, which supports them being close in age.
Xavi and Mina being close in age does not indicate anything about Fay being youngest.
If Xavi and Mina are both a year older than Fay, Fay is younger than at least those two, supporting the claim that Fay was youngest overall.
Fay being youngest has no bearing on which houses Mina and Jude belong to.
Mina and Jude being in different houses is unrelated to players comparing standings on a chalkboard.
Mina and Jude being in different houses supports the idea that there are at least two houses, consistent with the school having two houses.
Comparing standings near the end of the session and then helping clean up afterward are sequential but unrelated actions.
